name: 315L Neopower all-in-one
tagline: A 315 litre R290 all-in-one heat pump sized for four to six people.
summary: The Neopower Black Diamond is an all-in-one heat pump hot water system designed for Australian conditions. The 315 litre model suits households of four to six people.
It runs on R290 natural refrigerant, works in air temperatures down to -7°C, and is controlled from a touch screen or a phone app over Wi-Fi.

image.alt: Neopower 315L Neopower all-in-one black heat pump, front and side

highlights.title: Efficient heating
highlights.text: Turns 1kW of electricity into 4kW of heat by drawing warmth from the surrounding air.

highlights.title: R290 refrigerant
highlights.text: A natural refrigerant with low ozone-depleting properties and an extremely low GWP.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi app control
highlights.text: Control and monitor the system remotely with a free app, or use the touch screen.

highlights.title: Three anodes
highlights.text: Triple corrosion protection reduces maintenance, which helps in hard water areas.

highlights.title: Four operating modes
highlights.text: Choose Standard, Economy, Hybrid or Heating element mode to suit how you use hot water.

highlights.title: Solar PV compatible
highlights.text: Compatible with solar PV systems, with built-in frost protection and quiet operation.
